############## BLGS 1304 dataset Description#######################################################
#         BLGS 1304 is a dataset of 1304 Non-redundant PDB chain of Beta Buldges Type S.
#         PDB resolution is maximum 3 Angstrom and PDB chain length is minimum 80 amino acid.
#         This dataset is generated using PROMOTIF and Blastclust (25%).
#         There are three line in each PDB, First line is PDB ID with chain,
#         Second is  amino acid sequence in single letter code
#         and third line is assignment of Beta Buldge type S at each amino acid residue
#         corresponding to amino acid of respective PDB sequence, where plus (+) sign indicate
#         the corresponding amino acid occur in Beta buldge Type S while sign(-) indicates
#         non Beta-buldge Type S amino acid residues.
#################### Dataset Description end    #################################################
